target_claim: Assume, for the sake of contradiction, that both $G$ and $\bar G$ are nonplanar. Then $$\lvert{E(G)}\rvert+\lvert{E(\bar G)}\rvert \le (3\lvert{V(G)}\rvert-6)+(3\lvert{V(\bar G)}\rvert-6)=54. \Rightarrow\Leftarrow$$
source_quote: Assume, for the sake of contradiction, that both $G$ and $\bar G$ are nonplanar. Then $$\lvert{E(G)}\rvert+\lvert{E(\bar G)}\rvert \le (3\lvert{V(G)}\rvert-6)+(3\lvert{V(\bar G)}\rvert-6)=54. \Rightarrow\Leftarrow$$
